modal.help_s1b: Sauya Drives don dukan kundin, + Ƙara jaka don mannewa, x ta cire ɗaya, ko liƙa hanyoyin da aka raba da `;` cikin Gyara. Sauya shafuka ya sauya jakunkuna.
modal.help_s2b: Suna, Regex (daidaiton Rust), Fuzzy, Abun cikin fayil, Glob (*.rs), Daya-daga (KO) / Babu-daya-daga (BA), girma (baiti ko 10M/1G), kwanakin wata (YYYY-MM-DD), jerin Kebanta, Karin suna ko gutsun ƙungiyoyi (ya maye gurbi, danna kuma don sharewa; Gudanar ya gyara na musamman), Yi watsi da girman harafi, Nuna ɓoyayyu.
modal.help_s3b: Babban maballin Duba ka bincika ko Enter. Sabunta ya sake gudanarwa yana riƙe zaɓi. Kai tsaye ya gudanar da kansa (a kashe yake). Bincike babu komai ba ya gudana — sa * a Glob don komai.
modal.help_s4b: Ƙananan lakabi na jerewa, Je ya tsallaka shafuka, akwatunan alama na ciyar da Kwafa hanyoyi / Matsar / Share da fitarwar CSV–TXT–HTML–Excel–RTF. Binciken da aka adana da hotunan Na kwanan nan na dawo da kowace matattara ciki har da jakunkuna, KO/BA, da ɓoyayyu.
modal.help_keys_body: Enter ya bincika · Esc ya sauke hankali / ya rufe maganganu · ↑/↓ ya motsa zaɓi · Space ya alama layi · Tab ya motsa tsakanin sarrafawa.
